yt_title: Why Does A Balloon Stick To A Wall? Static Trick #Shorts
desc: Why does a balloon stick to a wall? Rubbing it moves electrons onto the balloon, and static electricity does the rest. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Static electricity at home! 🎈 Ask an adult to help. Will it stick for you? Comment YES or NO. Follow for a fact every day.

lines.text: This balloon should fall. It sticks to the wall.
Rub a balloon on your hair for ten seconds.
Press it to a wall. Then let go, slowly.
Rubbing moves tiny electrons from your hair onto the balloon.
The charged balloon pulls on the wall, so it sticks. This should fall. It does not.
